Not meant to scare any shorts but rather just challenge opinions etc. and just make sure you have a REAL plan.

As with everyone's obsession to fade the trade -- most think that e/r will solve all. In fact that's the crowded opinion "once they file they'll hit ATM and all is good"

Then they can raise. No quiet period. Etc.

But have you considered - what if they don't?

What if they wait?

What if it's just the start of the next major "catalyst" to walk people into a trap?

There is going to be a massive trade here, of course, but to me I just find the less crowded names = much better.

Think back to quantum. Yes there was a massive trade on "THE" day but, how many more massive trades were there AFTER "THE" day?

And on the day it did tank were you just making back prior losses?

Yes there is going to be a huge trade here, but prob best AFTER it cracks unless it actually speeds up and blows out some circuits etc. Still thinking same as I posted. Every day is just a new round of shorts letting out other shorts. Perpetual squeezer.

Just my two cents. I think there is better edge w/o risk of ruin.
